about.bio: I build mobile apps and websites end to end: design, code, data and launch. My background is senior iOS engineering in FinTech and global consultancies, and I now also deliver web projects for small businesses. My focus is clear scope, reliable delivery and results the client can measure.
highlights: Own projects from design to production: I designed and built Frabazar's online store and the Andes Workwear website on my own.
AI in daily work: Claude Code skills and agents with human review of every change, and on-device AI with Apple Foundation Models in MuscleCheck.
Technical mentorship through code reviews, best-practice advocacy, and support for junior developers.
Communication in Spanish (native) and English (B2), used with international teams and clients.

projects.name: Frabazar
projects.description: Online store for a home-goods shop in Buenos Aires. I designed and built it on my own: product catalog with categories, product pages, a cart that sends the order by WhatsApp, and shipping and contact pages. Products are managed in Airtable. It is live and already selling: customers browse on their phone, fill the cart and send the order in one tap.

projects.name: Andes Workwear
projects.description: Website for a workwear and uniforms company in Canada. I built the whole site: Home, Products and Contact pages, a clear "Get a quote" call to action, and contact through email, phone and WhatsApp.

projects.name: MuscleCheck
projects.description: Training tracker that I build and run on my own, native on both platforms: iOS in SwiftUI and SwiftData, and a full Android port in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It includes HealthKit, widgets, Siri shortcuts, RevenueCat subscriptions, on-device AI with Apple Foundation Models, and 4 languages.

bullets: Delivered Apple Wallet card tokenization and contactless NFC payments for a Puerto Rican bank.
Built a Fastlane CI/CD pipeline for builds, XCUITest suites and App Store distribution, cutting manual deployment effort by 90%.
Built wrappers exposing third-party SDKs to a low-code platform, bridging Objective-C and Swift.
Automated development workflows with Claude Code skills and agents, with human review of every change.
Architected reusable Swift frameworks adopted across multiple client projects, managed with CocoaPods and SPM.
Built a React Native app with native iOS modules: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and real-time notifications.
Delivered features in a distributed Buenos Aires-Chicago Agile team using TDD, with full VoiceOver accessibility.
Shipped camera capture, Bluetooth BLE and Core Location features for a production logistics app.
Shipped features and fixed production bugs in a Scrum team, with Firebase Crashlytics and Authentication.
Ran A/B tests in a retail banking app and built adaptive Auto Layout interfaces for all iPhone sizes.
